data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding reduced from GBP 1,231.8m at 1 January 2019 to GBP 1,124.0m at 31 December 2019 (a gross release of c. GBP 107.8m overall). However, management highlight adverse development on the 2018 and earlier years of account which materially impacted the underwriting result; several natural catastrophe events (2016-2018 hurricanes, earthquakes and California wildfires) contributed to prior-year losses. The report does not present a single explicit gross prior-year development number; gross PYD is not separately quantified in a dedicated 'prior year movement' gross line, and the movements reported combine current year and prior year changes.
raw_causal_phrases: relates primarily to losses arising on the development of the 2018 and prior years of account.
The 2019 year was impacted by the higher than expected losses on prior years of account.
Underwriting losses of GBP 149.5m over the period 2015 - 2019, generating an average combined ratio of 107.0%.
The 2016 year was impacted by natural catastrophe losses on the Alberta wildfires and hurricane Matthew with net losses of GBP 17.9m.

The 2017 year was impacted by several natural catastrophes with net losses of GBP 74.6m; hurricane Harvey; hurricane Irma; hurricane Maria; Mexico earthquake; Northern and Southern California wildfires.
The 2018 year was impacted by natural catastrophe net losses of GBP 22.8m; California Wildfires; hurricane Florence; hurricane Michael.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) 2018 comparative column = GBP 1,231,828k. The report does not present a single explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure; available movements mix current-year and prior-year changes. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes but the PDF text extraction here is misaligned such that reliable per-cell extraction was not possible; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null rather than risk an incorrect gross PYD number. Net prior-year impacts are discussed in the narrative (net figures quoted for years 2016, 2017, 2018) and total gross reserves movement for 2019 (reduction of GBP 107.833m) is available but includes current-year movement.
